title: Unseal (Immortal Tailed Beast Extraction)
body:
Syntax: unseal list
        unseal <player name>
        unseal player <player name>
        unseal mob <beast name or tail number 1-9>
        unseal beast <beast name or tail number 1-9>

Immortal-only. Free a sealed Tailed Beast from its jinchuriki, online or offline, without defeating the host. Example: unseal mob Kurama; unseal mob 9; unseal Biran. The freed Beast is spawned into the world as a real roaming aggressive mob and announced to the entire MUD. The former holder loses the Beast, its mastery, active Beast Mode and rampage. Saved immediately, including offline characters. Respects the one-roaming-beast limit and will not duplicate a beast. Use unseal list to see current sealed beasts and their holders. This does not release players from Reaper Death Seal; that is a separate player-only fuinjutsu.
